observations: Photo shows a bicycle lying/leaning indoors against a wall.
Front wheel and fork are visible; rear wheel is also visible.
Frame appears to be a used/second-hand bicycle with some wear.
No readable brand/model markings are visible in the photo.
No clear view of drivetrain/gear shifters or any label that confirms 'Belgium standard' or 'break is would gear'.

claims.claim: Very affordable Belgium standard break is would gear is working perfectly
claims.evidence: Photo does not show brake condition, gear/shifter function, or any test evidence.
Negotiation is not verifiable from the photo.

risks.risk: Brakes may not work properly (pads worn, cable issues, warped rotor/rim).
risks.proof: Short video of a safe test: squeeze brake levers while stationary and show the bike stopping; close-up of brake pads/lining and cable/lever condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if brakes are not guaranteed (worst case: needs brake service).

risks.risk: Gears may not shift correctly (derailleur misalignment, bent derailleur hanger, worn cassette/chain).
risks.proof: Video while pedaling: shift through all gears (front and rear if present) showing clean engagement; close-up of shifters and derailleur.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if gears may be faulty (worst case: needs gear/derailleur/chain service).

risks.risk: Wheel alignment/tyre condition (bent rim, bad bearings, punctures).
risks.proof: Photos of both wheels close-up: tyre tread and sidewall, and a spin test video showing wobble; check hub/bearing play.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if tyres/bearings may need replacement.

risks.risk: Frame damage or rust at joints (hidden cracks).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame welds/joints and any rust spots; ask for a quick inspection report or additional angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used bike with possible cosmetic wear and unknown structural condition.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the brake system (front and rear) and the gear shifters/derailleurs.
Short video test: brakes (stop test) and gear shifting through all gears while pedaling.
Close-up photos of chain, cassette/freewheel, and both tyres; plus a wheel spin/wobble video.
response.reason: The photo confirms it’s a used bicycle, but it does not provide proof that brakes and gears work perfectly or that the condition matches the seller’s claims. To price confidently, you need brake and gear test evidence.
